$description: Semantic motion recipes. Each is one measured behaviour; `reducedMotionFallback` is what a generated page must do under prefers-reduced-motion (the clone implements these in src/index.css and the per-area stylesheets). A PageSpec node picks a recipe id as motion.pattern; the schema const-locks the fallback per recipe.

none.$description: No motion: element renders in its final state.

appear-rise.$description: Framer appear primitive: opacity 0.001 + y 200 to rest, 0.7s tween; staggered delays 0.2/0.3/0.4s with the lead/follow easings.

appear-spring-x.$description: Card slides in from x 150 with a spring (duration 0.4, bounce 0.2).

scroll-reveal-spring.$description: Elements rise from y 50 (80 for the first) with a spring (duration 1, bounce 0.2) once 50% in view; once only.

chat-stagger.$description: Chat rows fade + rise (+50/+80px), opacity .5s chat-fade, transform .6s chat-spring, staggered delays.

ticker-horizontal.$description: Logo row translates linearly forever (list duplicated); 30 px/s, 45 px/s on compare pages; no hover pause.

ticker-vertical.$description: Three masked columns scroll up/down/up at ~10 px/s.

slide-horizontal.$description: Prev/Next slider: outgoing and incoming slides translate together, 300ms slide easing; no autoplay; loops.

crossfade-page.$description: Carousel page change: track opacity 1 to 0 (~120ms), swap, 0 to 1 (~120ms).

sticky-step-switch.$description: Sticky visual pinned beside scrolling blocks; the visual variant swaps instantly when the next block crosses 50% of the viewport, then its elements run chat-stagger.

count-up.$description: Counter animates 25 to 80 over 1.5s easeInOut the first time it enters the viewport; fades in.

accordion.$description: Single-open accordion: height + opacity, ~100ms linear (FAQ) or 240ms (open roles panel); icon swaps instantly.

hscroll-scrub.$description: Vertical scroll drives a horizontal track inside a sticky viewport; value smoothed (settles ~550ms).

typewriter-loop.$description: Types a phrase (~65ms/char), holds ~1s, deletes (~17ms/char), next phrase; loops.

timer-progress.$description: Auto-advancing list: active item's 1px bar fills over ~9s, then the next item activates; loops.

autoplay-carousel.$description: Slideshow advances one card every 1.5s with a spring; pauses off-screen.

orbit-rotate.$description: Logo chips rotate on concentric orbits (chips counter-rotate); continuous.

tile-glitch.$description: Decorative pixel tiles rise from y 150 (0.4s) on first visible pixel; replays (animateOnce false).
